title: Policy history: change metadata on policy_version + diff endpoint
context: Track 1 Compliance page asked for a Policy history tab that names, per version, who wrote the change and who authorised it (four-eye), free-text why, and what specifically changed vs the previous version. policy_version already had effective_from + superseded_at + approved_by, but nothing else. Rather than build a parallel policy_change table, the smallest thing that works is to extend policy_version itself.
decision: Extend policy_version with changed_by_user_id, changed_by_display, authorised_by_user_id, authorised_by_display, note, superseded_by_version_id — all NULLABLE so historical/seeded rows without a formal authoriser aren't retro-fitted. The diff is computed server-side by /compliance/policy/history against the prior row (ordered by effective_from desc) — never on the client, so the audit view can't disagree with a workpaper export.
scope_in: Migration d6a2e91b31c4 — six nullable columns on policy_version
PolicyVersion model updated to expose them
GET /compliance/policy/history — every version newest-first with is_current flag + pre-computed field-diff dict {field: {from, to}} vs the prior version
Compliance page: PolicyHistoryTab replaces the earlier stub with per-version card (fields + change metadata + note + diff strip)
scope_out_deferred: Enforcement of the four-eye control when a NEW policy version is written — no admin surface writes policy_version today, so there is no write path to gate. When one is added (Track 1 policy editor, not this ADR), the requester != authoriser rule should mirror ADR-0015.
Backfilling changed_by / authorised_by on seeded historical versions — they read 'not recorded' in the UI. Deliberate.
A dedicated audit_event when a policy version is written — captured separately whenever the policy editor lands.
invariants: The diff is server-side and read-only. Nothing on the compliance page mutates policy_version.

The 'current' version is the row with superseded_at IS NULL, enforced by the existing partial unique index ux_policy_current. superseded_by_version_id is a soft cross-reference, not a foreign key, to keep the migration safe on SQLite.

Field-level changes are computed only for policy content (concentration_cap_bp, threshold_analyst_pence, threshold_hot_pence, enforcement, fx_add_on_bp). Metadata like approved_by is displayed separately so its changes don't clutter the diff strip.
consequences: backend/alembic/versions/d6a2e91b31c4_policy_version_change_metadata.py — additive nullable columns via batch_alter for SQLite
frontend/app/compliance/page.tsx — stub replaced with the real tab
